about.heading: Bringing together technology and visual design, I'm working independently as a UI/UX designer in Ho Chi Minh City.

left.heading: My Design Philosophy
left.content: Every interface should guide users naturally, making interactions intuitive, accessible, and enjoyable. With a background in Software Engineering, I approach design with both creativity and practicality in mind, creating solutions that are visually refined, technically feasible, and ready for development.

right.heading: How I Work
right.content: Every project begins with understanding the problem before designing the solution. By learning about user needs and business goals, I create wireframes, user flows, and interfaces that prioritize clarity and usability.

journey.heading: Learning, Growing, and Designing Along the Way
journey.content: From studying Software Engineering to working across graphic design and UI/UX, each step has shaped my perspective as a designer. Every experience has strengthened my ability to solve problems, collaborate with teams, and create meaningful digital products.

items.title: VMAS
items.subtitle: Graphic Design Intern
content: Collaborated with the marketing team to create visual assets for campaigns across multiple digital platforms.
Worked closely with the creative team to produce engaging designs that aligned with brand identity and project objectives.

items.title: LAJO
items.subtitle: Design Trainee
content: Designed marketing materials for client events, workshops, and promotional campaigns while creating social media content for various platforms.
Also contributed to the early design phase of an online healthcare platform, helping shape the user experience for a doctor and hospital mobile application.

items.title: LPTECH
items.subtitle: UI/UX Designer
content: Designed responsive landing pages and mobile application interfaces with a focus on usability and visual consistency.
Collaborated closely with developers throughout the implementation process to ensure the final product accurately reflected the design vision and provided a seamless user experience.

items.title: TDTU
items.subtitle: Software Engineering
content: Built a strong foundation in web and mobile application development while gaining a broad understanding of software engineering principles.
Throughout my studies, I completed practical projects that strengthened both my technical knowledge and problem-solving skills.

tools.heading: My Creative Toolkit
tools.content: From design and prototyping to development and collaboration, these are the essential tools I use to create modern digital experiences from concept to implementation.
